item.title: LAW & ORDER – “Never Say Goodbye”– Review: The High Road is a Lonely Place
item.description: A Rare Hour That Earned My BreathlessnessThis was a rare Law & Order episode that earned my breathlessness. The victim, Mark Turner (Chamblee Ferguson), a 37-year retiree dropping aphorisms like breadcrumbs, offering a dying benediction about wearing a helmet — felt lived in, almost sainted. It’s the kind of poetic detail the show only hits when it slows down enough to let a character be human.“Never Say Goodbye” – LAW & ORDER. Pictured: David Ajala as Det. Theo Walker. Photo: Virginia Sherwood/
